notes.content: It is very important for students who intend to major in Physics, or obtain a single subject Teaching Credential in Science/Physics Emphasis, to complete most of the core preparatory courses listed below during their first two college years. By completing the 4 semesters of Mathematics, 3 semesters of Physics, and 2 semesters of Chemistry, students will be prepared to take upper-division Physics courses necessary for the major after transfer. Foreign Language Graduation Requirement Exemption: Students graduating with a Bachelor of Science Degree in Physics will not be subject to the University’s Foreign Language Graduation Requirement. Students who change major may be subject to the University’s Foreign Language Graduation Requirement. Students with an interest in theoretical physics are encouraged to consider a minor in Mathematics. For additional information, please visit: Department of Physics .
